scope: Production/candidate source and accounting review; machine evidence limited to candidate Windows/Node27. CONFORMS is explicitly scoped, not global certification.

rules.title: Pin realization-sensitive advice [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Exact localhost runtime/CPU/flags and distinct production/candidate identities recorded. This does not transplant Node26 reference costs to Node27.

rules.title: Stale-advice firewall [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Actual emitted Smi32 checks replace a rejected folklore assumption; no historical advice used as native-cost proof.

rules.title: State the mechanism and falsifier [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Debt entries state causal mechanism, governing unit, regression surface and falsifier.

rules.title: Qualify coherent changes, not individual edits [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Inherited correctness/performance reused for unchanged runtime; bounded diagnostics address a coherent audit uncertainty.

rules.title: Detection creates an investigation obligation, not mutation authority [STABLE]
rules.evidence: No hot mutation made merely because a detector or static review found work.

rules.title: Qualify at the governing optimization unit [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Full empty7x6 multiworker solve is the hot performance authority; local/code observations cannot promote candidates.

rules.title: Proxy metrics are subordinate evidence [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Assembly/site/GC counts are not elapsed-time or saving claims. Diagnostic TIMEOUT is not a performance rejection.

rules.title: Bind quantified ledgers to a cost profile [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Reference ledger/profile binding exists; complete active Node27/i5 closure and realization-sensitive cost binding remain incomplete (L1/L6/M4).

rules.title: No silent zero-cost operations [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Symbolic runtime/native costs remain named, but missing closure/callback aggregation prevents complete nonzero-cost assurance (L1/L2).

rules.title: Count executed operations, not source lines [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Confirmed failed accounting checks: actual roots, callee identities, callbacks, selectors and completion store (L1–L5). No owner-approved deviation invented.

rules.title: Model memory, branches, and synchronization explicitly [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Native-width/bank accesses are explicitly modeled, but completion-store count is wrong and actual builtin lowering exceeds bare-load accounting (L4/M4).

rules.title: Generated-code mapping is realization-sensitive [V8-SENSITIVE]
rules.evidence: New candidate assembly supports M1–M4; ledger does not completely represent its boxing/calls. Production and other OS machine mappings unqualified.

rules.title: Cycle sums are evidence, not elapsed-time proof [STABLE]
rules.evidence: No additive cycle sum reported as wall time; external whole-process CPU/cycles distinguished from primary solve.

rules.title: Preserve unresolved and blocking cost [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Regex and callback/root gaps prevent preservation of all unresolved cost through aggregation (L1–L3).

rules.title: Minimize unnecessary execution structure [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Complete source review exposes unresolved recurring cost; admissible lower-cost replacements not yet qualified.

rules.title: Semantics dominate optimization [STABLE]
rules.evidence: No semantic change. Inherited independent oracle, transition and full-suite checks retained; not universal proof.

rules.title: Separate semantic identity from addressing and occurrence [STABLE]
rules.evidence: TT address plus stored exact identity retained; full hash alone is not equality. Qualified collision/alias controls inherited.

rules.title: Optimize the dominant boundary first, without exempting smaller costs [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Representation/calls/boxing and recurring structural work prioritized while small ABI costs remain visible.

rules.title: Preserve superior composite realizations [STABLE]
rules.evidence: C34+C63 and other retained fusions protected; fallback work not deleted because compiled route supersedes only admitted cases.

rules.title: Minimize total machine cost [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Cost search completed for this audit; whole-runtime minimal-cost/maximal-optimization certification is not established.

rules.title: Classify candidate cost before calling it avoidable [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Every candidate is causal-classified; emitted work not called known avoidable absent full-solve qualification.

rules.title: Cost magnitude controls priority, not legitimacy [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Dead slot/tail and small repeated checks stay in debt, regardless of isolated magnitude.

rules.title: Optimize cycles and critical path, not instruction count alone [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Instruction/site counts are explanatory; elapsed/cycles at enclosing solve decide promotion.

rules.title: No "fast enough" stopping condition [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Optimization campaign remains open with durable debt. Audit completion is not a fast-enough optimization stopping claim or owner deferral.

rules.title: Maximal effort is not a claim of global optimality [STABLE]
rules.evidence: No global-optimality claim; current uncertainty and requalification triggers visible.

rules.title: Maximal effort governs search and disposition, not mandatory intervention [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Investigation/disposition performed without blindly intervening in superior composites.

rules.title: Normalize once at ingress [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Cold geometry/cache dispatch exists; caller-proved fact retests and unbounded history admission remain candidates (D7/C4).

rules.title: Preserve stronger upstream facts [STABLE]
rules.evidence: CPC/mover/full-column rechecks identified; removing them requires caller/fallback ownership proof.

rules.title: Cold failure and reporting path [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Formatting/discovery/errors external or cold; no hot reporting counters introduced.

rules.title: Builtins are candidate machine primitives [V8-SENSITIVE]
rules.evidence: No builtin replaced by folklore; actual Atomics calls and popcount helper retained as measured candidates.

rules.title: Domain-appropriate width [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Initialization-selected basis/index/cache widths and bank limits explicit; general exact fallback preserved through10x10. Large profiles not fully allocation-qualified.

rules.title: Stable internal representation [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Stable arenas exist, but uint32 boxing and negative-zero transport are emitted conversion debt (M1/M2).

rules.title: Structured facts remain structured [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Hot structured state consumed directly; no string/JSON reparsing in recurrence.

rules.title: One owner for derived facts [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Compiled plans/fused identity reused; remaining extraction/repacking/reflection work requires shared-overhead investigation.

rules.title: Eliminate avoidable E0 allocation [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Source-scope successful recurrence has no dynamic aggregate construction. Numeric HeapNumber paths are separately unresolved under XTRM/JIT; no machine-allocation-free claim.

rules.title: Allocation count is not lifetime cost [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Closed-app retention is source-established; lifecycle/retention cost and release qualification unresolved (C3). No pooling assumption.

rules.title: Prepare growth before entry [STABLE]
rules.evidence: TT, frames, scratch and support plans sealed before E0; no hot storage growth detected. E3 root allocation included in primary.

rules.title: Reuse must have ownership [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Rank-owned recursive arenas and stable scalars protect borrowed scratch; no escaping recursive scratch found. Closed-app ownership documented in audit.

rules.title: Complexity class is part of the implementation contract [STABLE]
rules.evidence: No rewrite/asymptotic regression in audit; fallback complexity and support-plan budgets explicit.

rules.title: Do not restart monotonic work [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Basis/reflection/pair-prefix scans and residual extraction remain candidate repeated work, not proven removable.

rules.title: Do not materialize to answer a projection [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Eager child/frontier/live products may be bypassed by certificates; guard/ownership economics unresolved.

rules.title: Exact single-pass construction when size is derivable [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Prepared buffers sized from geometry/profile; no E0 allocate-copy-shrink. One-shot root slices are E3.

rules.title: Precompute immutable finite relations [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Immutable support, closure, reflection and transition plans prepared within declared budgets; exact fallback retained.

rules.title: Compile stable structure when reuse amortizes compilation [STABLE]
rules.evidence: C66 compilation amortization/bytes/full-solve evidence inherited; budget fallback and code-size risks recorded.

rules.title: Simplify before general work [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Terminal/cache/forced gates exist; eager live/frontier work can precede child simplification (D5).

rules.title: Dispatch once [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Cold worker/layout selection exists; some fallback fixed-layout tests remain realization-sensitive debt.

rules.title: Prefer stable, bounded feedback over cargo-cult monomorphism [V8-SENSITIVE]
rules.evidence: Target traces inspected; complete production/fallback feedback behavior not established. Large recurrence retains helper calls.

rules.title: Stable object and element representations at repeated hot access sites [V8-SENSITIVE]
rules.evidence: Stable typed storage/source shapes evident; emitted guards/boxing and all-tier behavior not completely qualified.

rules.title: Source form is not generated-code proof [V8-SENSITIVE]
rules.evidence: Per-isolate machine evidence collected; static DCE/inlining/allocation assumptions explicitly limited.

rules.title: Coordination frequency below useful-work frequency [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Workers progress independently; cancellation/cache Atomics not reporting coordination. No pernode host rendezvous found.

rules.title: Visibility and execution are distinct [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Bounded cold-created workers and start gate; no task visibility creates new search workers.

rules.title: Shared state must minimize contention structure [STABLE]
rules.evidence: No hot global diagnostic counters; cache publication/contention remains semantic/coupled cost with no current PMU frequency attribution.

rules.title: Shared-memory correctness precedes speed [STABLE]
rules.evidence: Cache sequence/atomic payload protocol preserved and inherited busy/wrap/clone/collision tests pass. Not a new formal concurrency proof.

rules.title: Native is a boundary choice, not a performance rank [STABLE]
rules.evidence: FFI affinity is a cold boundary with ABI/OS constraints; no solver escape or native-is-faster assumption.

rules.title: Hot diagnostics are compact [STABLE]
rules.evidence: No source hot counters. Diagnostic runtime flags intentionally distort performance and are excluded from promotion.
